physical_acceptance.reason: Serial proved that synchronous microSD initialization consumed about 45 seconds before display, touch, and audio startup. Software audio writes alone were not acoustic acceptance. The core boot path must initialize display and branded audio before starting removable storage in the background.

conclusion: The exact image installed and remained serial-stable, but it failed the operator's core boot acceptance. This negative result is retained so a future verifier cannot restore storage-before-display ordering.
commit_policy: Commit this negative acceptance together with the corrected successor after the successor passes manual hardware acceptance.
